property_summary: For any inputs, calling transfer(...) on the correct contract always reverts (returns false via catch) when _tos is empty because it requires _tos.length>0 up-front; the mutant that removes the require allows a successful call (no revert) for empty _tos, so there exists inputs (empty _tos) where the mutant does not revert while the reference always reverts.
change_summary: Remove the require entirely so calls with empty _tos do not revert at the start.
